label: A single-piece interpolation
subgoals: Normalize the overdrive by two n kT/q
Evaluate ln of one plus e to the x
Square it to get the normalized current

label: The strong-inversion limit
subgoals: Approximate ln of one plus e to the x by x for large x
Recover the square law from F approximately x squared
Measure the ratio F over x squared to see the moderate-inversion gap

label: The weak-inversion limit
subgoals: Approximate ln of one plus e to the x by e to the x for very negative x
Measure the ratio F over e to the 2x approaching one
